# QR Code generator

Unmodified C library by Project Nayuki, MIT licensed (license in source headers).

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/3c6d0b3cefb4e049dc337e82237c9644399716a8/c

Only `qrcodegen.c` and `qrcodegen.h` are built. This independent encoder does not
pull the manufacturer's LVGL 8 QR widget into the port's LVGL 7 build.
